## Opening the Data

```{r echo = FALSE}
#Loading the data, removing the first row so that R can open it.
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

FluvPHL = read.csv('FluViewPhase2Data/ICL_NREVSS_Public_Health_Labs.csv', quote = "\"", skip = 1)
str(FluvPHL)
View(FluvPHL)

FluvCL = read.csv('FluViewPhase2Data/ICL_NREVSS_Clinical_Labs.csv', quote = "\"", skip = 1)
str(FluvCL)
View(FluvCL)
```

##Cleaning and Combining the data
An extraneous region column was removed, since all the data was national no other region data was recorded. All the rest of the data was relevant and tidy, so I simply then combined the two data-sets.

```{r echo = FALSE}
FluvCL_clean = FluvCL %>%
  select(-REGION)
View(FluvCL_clean)

FluvPHL_clean = FluvPHL %>%
  select(-REGION)
View(FluvPHL_clean)

Fluv_Complete = full_join(FluvCL_clean, FluvPHL_clean)
View(Fluv_Complete)
```
